'''''Planechanga''''' were large tubular [[Railgun/Legends|rail guns]] built by the [[Hutt Empire|empire]] of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]] prior to the [[Hutt Cataclysms]], a civil war within [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] that began around [[15,000 BBY/Legends|15,000 BBY]]. The weapons were capable of accelerating [[Realspace/Legends|space]] rocks to velocities at which they could crack open entire [[Planet/Legends|planets]]. To aid in building the weapons, the Hutts hired members of the [[Sakiyan/Legends|Sakiyan]] species, who recorded the payments in tribute-counts.<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
''Planechanga'' were first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', a reference book written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]] that was released in [[2012]].<ref name="EGTW" />
